outline:
積層製造(3D列印)加工原理、積層製造系統分類、加工參數與加工結果分析，製程設備研究，快速模具技術研究，積層製造與快速模具實習，專題研究與討論。

This course includes the principle of additive manufacturing process, classifications, process parameters, and the systems. The application of additive manufacturing will also introduce together with practice works. Two mini projects need to complete during this semester.
schedule:

1 The Development of Additive Manufacturing Systems

4,5 VPP (Photo-Polymerization Fabrication Process/ Basic knowledge of photo-polymerization)
6,7 MEX (Nozzle type Polymerization Fabrication Process/ Basic knowledge of liner polymer Thermal Plastic polymerization
)
8 MJT
9 BJT (Powder Fabrication Process/ Basic knowledge of metallurgy)
10 PBF
11 DED
12 SHL (Alternative Fabrication Process/ Basic knowledge of cutting)
13 Exam
14 Applications (Industrial, Medical, Potential)
15-18 mini projects in 3D printing Lab (224-1)
